title: `hasattr(fn, '__call__')` used twice to test callability; use `callable()` instead
detail: Lines 399 and 407 use `hasattr(fn, '__call__')` to distinguish a plain function from a descriptor. Ruff B004 warns that this is unreliable: some objects override `__getattr__` such that `hasattr(..., '__call__')` returns `True` even for non-callables. `callable(fn)` is the correct Python 3 API and delegates to `tp_call` in CPython. Suggested fix: replace both occurrences with `callable(fn)`.

title: `NovaEphemeralObject` does not override abstract `should_migrate_data` from `NovaObject`
detail: Pylint reports that `should_migrate_data` is abstract in `NovaObject` but not overridden in `NovaEphemeralObject` (line 223). If `should_migrate_data` is ever called on an `EphemeralObject` subclass the call will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class`. Suggested fix: add an explicit `should_migrate_data` implementation (likely returning `False`) on `NovaEphemeralObject`.
